ditto_definition: mean existing scaled-dot-product attention received by genes from 64 deterministic query tokens and 8 heads
ditto_centroid_definition: existing Q/K projections; per-head mean query attends to all keys; weights averaged over heads
module_representation: ordered concatenation of per-module contextual-token means or means+SDs
limitations: sampled incoming attention approximates rather than materializes the full 15165x15165 attention matrix
